sections.label: Why It Matters
sections.heading: Why Meta Ads Is Important for Your Business
sections.subheading: Because Your Audience Is Already on Facebook and Instagram.
sections.text: Many of your potential customers are active on Facebook and Instagram. Meta Ads helps your business connect with the right audience there, with messages and visuals made to catch attention.

sections.label: What I Offer
sections.heading: Meta Ads Services
sections.text: Every Meta Ads campaign starts with a clear objective. I plan campaigns around the goal that fits your business best.

sections.label: Why Work With Me
sections.heading: Why Meta Ads With Me
sections.text: Meta Ads is not just boosting posts or showing ads to a broad audience. Without clear targeting and purpose, budget can be spent without reaching the right people.

sections.heading: Ready to Reach the Right Audience?
sections.text: Let’s discuss your goals and explore how a targeted Meta Ads strategy can support your business.

faqs.question: What Meta Ads services do you offer?
faqs.answer: I run Facebook and Instagram campaigns for lead generation, awareness, sales, app promotion, traffic and engagement, along with audience targeting, retargeting and ongoing optimization and reporting.

faqs.question: Do you run ads on both Facebook and Instagram?
faqs.answer: Yes. I plan and manage campaigns across Facebook and Instagram using Meta Ads Manager.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee leads or sales?
faqs.answer: No one can honestly guarantee specific leads or sales. I focus on careful targeting, clear tracking, transparent reporting, and continuous campaign improvement.

faqs.question: Do you help with ad creatives?
faqs.answer: I guide the visuals and messaging so your offer is communicated clearly, and I work with tools like Canva for designs.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: You can get in touch through my contact form, email, or WhatsApp. We can discuss your requirements and explore the right approach for your business.
